goal: Implement scripts/run_checks.py and tests/test_run_checks.py in this newly created shared Actions repository. This is a small actual workflow utility. CLI: python scripts/run_checks.py FILE. FILE is a JSON list of 1..20 strict objects with only name (nonempty unique string), argv (nonempty list of strings) and timeout_seconds (integer 1..900, not bool). Validate the complete list before executing any commands. Run each argv directly using subprocess.run without a shell, inheriting the current working directory, with its declared timeout. Return exit 0 only if all checks exit 0; return nonzero with concise diagnostic for invalid input, unavailable command, timeout or failed command. Stop after the first failure. No installs or network calls. Test with real temporary scripts/processes: success, failure preventing the later marker, full validation before side effects, literal shell characters, invalid JSON and timeout. Use only Python standard library. Read README.md and checks.example.json in one focused command; code this small utility and tests, then return structured result. The executor runs all declared checks; do not duplicate them. Do not expand scope or explore unrelated repositories.
acceptance_criteria: Argument-array checks execute with no shell.
Invalid configurations have no execution side effects.
Failures/timeouts stop subsequent checks and return nonzero.

policy.authorization_reference: User request on 2026-10-04 to complete executor controls, multi-repository support and real agent validation.
